The mechanism

A stud earring has two parts.
We left one of them out.

The difference sits behind the ear, where nobody photographs it. Two drawings show it: the stud you know, and ours.

Until now

Post, back, friction.

The back holds by clamping force alone. It comes off when you change clothes, it catches on your scarf, it drops down the plughole. And it is exactly the part people keep buying again.

One part too many
Click-Lock

Post, quarter turn, click.

At the end of the post sits a T-shaped anchor. Lengthwise it goes through the piercing like an ordinary stud. A quarter turn, and it lies crosswise behind it. No back. Nothing to lose.

One part, and it stays
Push in, turn, click. Try the fastening

Sterling silver 925

The jewellery is real silver, depending on the model rhodium-plated, plated with 18 carat gold or set with enamel. Only the post that goes through the piercing is surgical stainless steel. The full material list is on every product page.

Stays in in the shower and in the sea

Water-resistant, every day. You do not need to take them out for sport, and not for sleeping either. One exception, and we name it ourselves: models with a real pearl are better taken out for showering and swimming, and that is on their product page too.

You set the grip yourself

If the fastening sits too loosely or too tightly, you move the turned part of the post along a little. That works with one hand, without a mirror, without tools. A back cannot do that.

Our selection

Find yours.

Fifteen models, one fastening. Every one comes as a pair and as a single earring, for the second piercing or for mixing. The single price is on every card, so you can place the pair price.

The Click-Lock

A fastening
that stays.

No back. No searching. No losing. The T‑bar slides through the ear, turns, clicks and settles crossways. Eight years of precision work, one movement.

01

Push in

The post slides through your piercing like any ordinary stud.

02

A quarter turn on the earring. That's all it takes.

03

The T‑bar locks in crossways. It's on. Forget backs.

Before you buy

Three questions we would rather answer beforehand.

Before the first pair, it is nearly always the same three doubts. Here is the answer to each, including where it speaks against us.

Does it really hold?

Yes. The fastening only opens when you deliberately turn it back. Showering, sport, sleeping: it stays where it is. Do not simply take our word for it, try the demo and give it a tug.

To the demo

Will it fit me?

Nearly always, but not always. Behind the earlobe, the anchor needs room for the quarter turn. On very thick earlobes it cannot rotate. We would rather say so before than after.

Measure and ask us

And if not?

30-day returns from receipt, unworn and in the original packaging. On production faults, one year from purchase: with proof of purchase we repair or replace, free of charge.

The whole story
After the click

What happens when you order.

No account, no surprises. The whole route is set out here, from ordering to returning.

01

Ordering

Two steps, no account. Then three emails follow: the receipt, the acceptance after the stock check, and the dispatch notice with a tracking number. You pay with TWINT, card, PayPal, Apple Pay or Google Pay.

02

Arriving

We ship from two warehouses. Switzerland, Germany, Austria, Liechtenstein, France and Italy are served from Switzerland, all other countries from Japan. Shipping is free from an order value of CHF 99, below that a flat rate applies, which you see in your cart. Every order arrives in the Baqless packaging.

[Exact rates, delivery times and the customs arrangement per country will be added before going live.]

03

Sending back

30 days from receipt, unworn and in the original packaging. The procedure, the form and the address are under Shipping & returns. If it does not suit you, tell us briefly why. That helps us more than a silent return.
